codigoAyuda: Three letters that identify the company (for example, AGR for Agroindustrial Norte). Every user's PIN starts with them: the PIN is 7 characters, the code and 4 random ones. It can't be repeated; only AGROCOM can change it later.
adminInicialAyuda: The person who manages the account from the app: they receive the first PIN and from there create the other users, the doors each can use and their roles.
creadaTexto: {{cuenta}} can now sign in to the app.
pinUnaVez: This PIN won't be shown again. Copy it and hand it to the administrator. If it's lost, you'll have to reset it.
irCuenta: I've copied it, go to the account
responsableAyuda: The person at the company AGROCOM deals with about the account, subscription and payments. They don't have to use the app: the administrator created in step 3 does.
correoAyuda: Expirations and charges will be notified here.
pagoAyuda: The account starts operating when its first payment is recorded.
pagoDespuesTexto: The account is created pending payment: the administrator gets their PIN, but nothing opens until you record the payment from Collections.
creadaPendienteTexto: {{cuenta}} was created and is pending payment.
creadaPendienteAviso: Until the first payment is recorded, the account issues no QR and opens no doors. It shows up in Collections as “To activate”.
